How This Curriculum Connects to SAP's AI Strategy

When you're working through a curriculum unit on positioning or competitive intelligence, it can be easy to lose sight of how these skills connect to the larger transformation happening across SAP. The new article maps the dots — showing how each unit in the curriculum aligns to the company's Focus Programs and Autonomous Enterprise vision.

The Autonomous Enterprise

"All-in on AI" isn't just a tagline — it's a coordinated transformation across every function.

The article breaks down the 6 GTM Focus Programs and 3 Corporate Functions programs, showing exactly which curriculum units build the skills each one requires.

Whether you're working on AI-Powered CRM adoption, helping customers navigate Clean Core migrations, or building competitive positioning against hyperscalers — the curriculum has something directly relevant to your Focus Program.
